name: thin-plate elements
domain: 车辆轨道结构与数值方法
definition_zh: 按薄板假设离散轨道板和混凝土底座的单元。
usage_note: 文中采用薄板单元建模板类部件，不能直接扩展为厚板剪切模型。
usage_overview: 常用于轨道板、底座板等板类部件的有限元离散，描述其弯曲变形、应变及连接点运动，并纳入车辆—轨道—桥梁等耦合动力分析。建模基于薄板假设，不能直接扩展为考虑厚板剪切变形的模型。

complete_examples.text: In the track segment element, the rails are modeled as elastic Bernoulli–Euler beams supported by discrete viscoelastic rail pads that are assumed to be linear springs and dashpots; moreover, the track slabs are modeled as thin-plate elements, which are connected to the subgrade through the cement asphalt mortar (CA mortar) layer that are regarded as continuous plane springs and dashpots.

(Xr, Yr, and Zr) and the rotation around them (/Xr, /Yr, and uZr); thus, the rail beam element has 24 DOFs; moreover, the track slabs are modeled as thin-plate elements, in the vertical direction, each node of the thin-plate has DOFs of vertical displacement (Zs) and rotations around X-axis and Y-axis (/Xs and /Ys); in the lateral direction, there is displacement along Y-axis (Ys) and rotation around Z-axis (/Zs), namely the slab track element has 16 DOFs.
The rail is modeled as a Bernoulli–Euler beam, the track slab and concrete basement are modeled as an assemblage of thin-plate elements.
